name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node 22
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Install pnpm 9
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 9
          run_install: false

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --include-workspace-root

      - name: Trim devDependencies from lockfile
        run: |
          pnpm add -D yaml
          node - <<'NODE'
          const fs = require('fs');
          const yaml = require('yaml');
          const lockPath = 'pnpm-lock.yaml';
          const lock = yaml.parse(fs.readFileSync(lockPath, 'utf8'));
          if (lock.packages) {
            for (const pkgKey in lock.packages) {
              const pkg = lock.packages[pkgKey];
              if (pkg.dev) {
                delete pkg.dev;
              }
            }
          }
          fs.writeFileSync(lockPath, yaml.stringify(lock));
          NODE

      - name: Run tests
        run: pnpm test

      - name: Run lint
        run: pnpm lint

      - name: Run build
        run: pnpm build

  all-green:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: re-actors/alls-green@release/v1
        with:
          jobs: build
